Our latest stories

  • Don’t: How using the right words will change your life. An author talk with Bob Selden, 23 July
    13 July 2026
    Stop walking away from conversations wishing you'd said it differently. Best-selling author Bob Selden will help you make the simple word changes that will change your life.

  • New Zealand Aotearoa music in fiction, fact and verse | 1 August
    9 July 2026
    Join us for this music-focused event featuring debut novelist Nick Sceats, poet and music journalist Simon Sweetman, and Richard Langston, author of The Clean: In the Dreamlife You Need a Rubber Soul

  • Guest post: The words that will make your business apology sincere
    8 July 2026
    Bob Selden, best-selling author shares an excerpt from the revised edition of his book, Don’t: How using the right words will change your life.

  • Matariki eBook Club: Witi Ihimaera's Te Kaikaukau | The Swimmer
    6 July 2026
    Join us in reading our WCL eBook Club pick for July: 'Te Kaikaukau | The Swimmer' by Witi Ihimaera!

  • Guest post: Hot Desking - The Pros and Cons
    1 July 2026
    Hot desking is often a controversial choice in an office workspace. This guest post presents the pros and cons of hot desking.

  • Matariki 2026: Pukapuka for tamariki
    29 June 2026
    To accompany our Matariki me Puanga reading challenge, we've put together some booklists for tamariki to enjoy.

  • 40th Anniversary of Homosexual Law Reform: Reading list and zine event!
    27 June 2026
    Explore a range of library resources, reading lists and events to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the Homosexual Law Reform Act 1986.

  • Winter School Holiday Programme 2026
    25 June 2026
    Mānawatia a Matariki me Puanga! Dive into the magic of Matariki and Puanga at your library over the holidays!

  • Between the Lines: Private Lives
    25 June 2026
    The theme of our June musical book club is Private Lives.

  • Book Launch: Out of the box | Saturday 18 July
    24 June 2026
    Join us for an afternoon of dance, music and poetry celebrating Deaf and Disability Pride Month.

  • Running the Show: An Interview with Fergus Kisby-MacLeod, General Manager of the Penthouse Cinema
    24 June 2026
    In Wellington City Libraries' latest local business interview, we chat with Fergus Kisby-MacLeod, the third generation of the Kisby family to be Penthouse cinema kaitiaki.

  • Chinese Language Week - in traditional Chinese 新西蘭中文周
    23 June 2026

  • Dealing with Difficult People
    17 June 2026
    We've compiled some resources to help readers navigate the challenging personalities we may encounter in a work situation.

  • A new story for Te Ara Pukapuka at ki Paekākā
    15 June 2026
    Our children's book walk at Wellington Botanic Garden has been refreshed for the chilly season with a new story!

  • Making Small Talk: building connections through simple conversations
    10 June 2026
    Small talk, or the art of making conversation with strangers, is part of business networking but not always something that comes naturally to many people. We've got resources to help.

  • The Wellington Comic Lover's Guide to... The Incredible Hulk
    9 June 2026
    Our comics collection is the strongest one there is! It’s the Wellington Comic Lover’s Guide to the Incredible Hulk!

  • Tūhono 2026 – We Want Your Poems
    5 June 2026
    Submissions on the theme of 'Te Taiao | Nature' for our biennial poetry journal for young writers are opening on the 29th of June!

    3 June 2026
    Leadership trainer, strategist and speaker Fleur Marks shares an edited extract from her new book, The Overachiever’s Reset: A Better Way to Succeed Without Losing Yourself.
